overview_description.description: Nowports is a digital freight forwarder that helps companies improve the import process. It serves as a platform through which companies and individuals can manage their imports and exports in real-time. The company uses AI to make the import process easy, secure, and transparent. The platform allows users to request a quote, register the products and providers that the company mostly uses, and book shipments from any port.

about_short_description.short_description: Nowports is a digital freight forwarder that automates the supply chain process of companies.

product.name: Nowports Digital Freight Forwarder Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that centralizes logistics and supply chain management, providing document management, shipment tracking, alerts, and reporting for international cargo operations.

product.name: Ocean Freight Forwarding Services
product.description: Services for transporting cargo by sea, including containerized, bulk, refrigerated, and liquid cargo, with shipment tracking and risk management.

product.name: Air Freight Forwarding Services
product.description: Air cargo transportation services for high-value or fragile goods with real-time tracking and document management.

product.name: Ground Freight Forwarding Services
product.description: Transportation of cargo by land across Latin America with tailored solutions for various cargo types and real-time shipment visibility.

identifier.value: Cargo and Container Insurance and Risk Management

product.name: Cargo and Container Insurance and Risk Management
product.description: Risk management services including cargo and container insurance, GPS tracking, and customized policies to protect shipments during transit.
